claims: A golf Grand Slam involves winning The Masters, PGA Championship, U.S. Open, and The Open Championship either in a single calendar year or over a career.
Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tiger Woods, and Rory McIlroy.
Rory McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam at the 2025 Masters.
Bobby Jones achieved a calendar-year Grand Slam in 1930.
Bobby Jones won the U.S. Open, The Open, U.S. Amateur, and British Amateur in 1930.
The calendar-year Grand Slam has not been done in the modern era.
Rory McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam in 2025.
Tiger Woods held all four modern major titles simultaneously during 2000-2001.
Tiger Woods did not win all four modern major titles in the same calendar year during the Tiger Slam.
As of early 2026, 12 players have won three of the four major championships.
Scottie Scheffler has won the Masters, PGA Championship, and The Open Championship.
In women's golf, a career Grand Slam includes winning four different majors.
Karrie Webb has accomplished a career Grand Slam in women's golf.
The PGA Grand Slam of Golf was a separate exhibition tournament for major winners.
The PGA Grand Slam of Golf was discontinued in 2015.
The Masters Tournament is held in April.
The PGA Championship is held in May.
The U.S. Open is held in June.
The Open Championship is held in July.
